verdict.rationale: Loops documents a workflow engine where users (or agents via API/CLI/MCP) create workflow graphs, publish them, and trigger them with events so email sequences (onboarding, activation, winback) run autonomously without manual intervention thereafter (loops-docs-27, loops-docs-30, loops-docs-15, loops-docs-3). Programmatic access via API/CLI/MCP means an AI-native user can set these up without touching the UI. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration that workflows run reliably unattended, and more detail on monitoring/error-handling for background execution.
